**Claim:** `domain:services` execution seat, session `session_01APWX2AwT3a4xDcjPCe8bk4` (`os-sam`). Branch `claude/issue-11380-scim-parity-gate-ctor`. R7 batch.

`pm:queue` → `pm:dispatched` + assigned in one write, before this comment. An earlier claim under a different session ID outranks this one — say so and I stand down.

**Decision re-read done.** This card was filed by triage executing the maintainer ruling on **#3653** (`3653#issuecomment-5386678763`), which parked the migration decision and made this card its unblocker:

> **Ruled: repair the parity gate first, then rule the migration path on the real seven-model diff** — the card's four load-bearing claims were overturned by measurement […] so the migration fork is not ripe. `needs-user-decision` → `pm:blocked`; the gate repair is filed as #11380 and this card returns for its ruling when the diff is posted here.

## Zone 1 — scope. ⛔ Hard boundary.

**Gate repair + one diff run + posting the diff on #3653. That is the entire deliverable.**

⛔ **NOT the migration.** ⛔ Do not upgrade the `@better-auth/scim` pin (`plugin-auth/package.json:29`, currently `1.7.0-rc.1`). ⛔ Do not touch `auth-manager.ts`'s `scim({...})` call. ⛔ Do not delete either scaffold `peerDependencyRules.allowedVersions` suppression — those retire **with** the migration, not with this card. ⛔ `packages/spec` zero ownership — the `SCIMGroupSchema` question is #3653's, not yours.

#3653 is `pm:blocked` **on this card**. The faster and narrower this lands, the sooner the maintainer has a real diff to rule on. A wide PR here delays the thing it exists to unblock.

## Zone 1 — the measured defect. ⛔ Do not re-derive.

From #3653's dev report `5386605190`:

> The parity gate **dies in its collection phase with a `TypeError`** before it can print the seven-model diff it promises. The diff only appears **after** the constructor call is fixed.

⚠️ And the reason this matters beyond tidiness, which should be stated in the PR body: the gate was written down on #3653 as *the safety net for the migration moment* — "the gate will report all seven model differences the instant you upgrade". **It does not open at the promised moment.** A migrator hits an uninformative `TypeError` instead of a model-difference list. That is a declared-not-enforced guard, and repairing it is the point.

## Zone 2 — my mechanism assumptions. ⚠️ Falsify me; measurement wins.

1. The failure is a **constructor call-shape mismatch** — the gate constructs a vendor object with an argument shape 1.7.1 no longer accepts — and the repair is at the call site, **not** in the gate's comparison logic. ⚠️ If the diff logic downstream is *also* written against the five-model world and would produce a wrong or empty diff even once collection succeeds, **that is in scope** (the acceptance is a correct diff, not merely a non-crashing run) — but say plainly which of the two you found.
2. The gate can reach 1.7.1 **without** the workspace moving to it — via a devDependency, an explicit version fetch, or whatever the gate already does. ⚠️ If reaching 1.7.1 requires moving the workspace pin, **stop and report**: that is the migration, and it is #3653's ruling to make, not yours to fold in.
3. Seven models plus a **conditional managed-connections directory** (3 further models) is the expected shape. Do not treat "seven" as a target to make the output match — **report what the gate prints**, and if it is not seven, that reading is more valuable than a tidy one.

## Zone 3 — suggested route

Reproduce the `TypeError` first and quote it, so the repair has a before. Fix the call. Run the gate. Post the produced diff — **the actual output, not a summary of it** — as a comment on **#3653**, since that is where the ruling resumes. Cross-link from here.

## Clause-② — `no`

Judged from card content, not paths: this repairs a gate's own construction so it reaches its diff-printing stage. It changes **no product accept/reject behaviour** and widens **no public surface**. ⚠️ If your repair turns out to require touching product code rather than the gate, **re-grade and tell me** — do not carry a `no` that stopped being true.

Standing operational note from #3653, unchanged and still true: SCIM is default-off; **group provisioning is not wired** — deployments with SCIM enabled must not let the IdP push groups until the migration lands.

## Method requirements

- Gate union from `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` with **no hand-supplied paths**. `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` and lock `exit 99` are **NOT MEASURED** — never report either as a pass.
- **Zero-hit needs a reverse control** before it counts.
- ⛔ Worktree-first, per repo. ⛔ Never `git stash`. ⛔ Never touch `content/docs/releases/**`.

**Diff produced and posted.** The repaired gate's run against the published `@better-auth/scim@1.7.1` is on #3653, verbatim: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/3653#issuecomment-5387582046 — that is where the migration ruling resumes.

Draft PR: #11429. Gate-only (one test file), `skip-changeset`; the pin, `auth-manager.ts`, both scaffold suppressions and `packages/spec` are untouched. 1.7.1 was reached through the gitignored pnpm virtual store, so no tracked manifest moved.

Reading, in one line: seven unmapped models where four are acknowledged, `scimProvider` gone, ten models if `managedConnections` is ever configured — and on the pinned rc.1 the gate is unchanged at `24 passed (24)`.

## PM 复核 PR #11429 —— **ACCEPT**。⛔ 尚未翻牌(CI 未收敛),已挂自检回来完成

复核对象是树与 diff。**⭐ 本卡的存在理由已经兑现:diff 已贴在 #3653(`5387582046`),逐字原文,而 #3653 已因此从 `pm:blocked` 移回 `needs-user-decision`。**

### 硬边界:全部守住

diff 是**恰好一个文件**,`better-auth-schema-parity.test.ts`,+93/−3。

⛔ pin 仍是 `1.7.0-rc.1`(`plugin-auth/package.json:29`)· ⛔ `auth-manager.ts` 未动 · ⛔ 两处脚手架 `peerDependencyRules` 抑制未动 · ⛔ `packages/spec` 未动。⇒ **Clause-② `no` 成立**,不是继承的。

它是怎么在**不移 pin** 的情况下读到 1.7.1 的:把发布的 tarball 解到 worktree 的 **gitignored** pnpm 虚拟仓库,按 run 把包的 `node_modules` 符号链接指过去,`trap` 在 `EXIT/INT/TERM` 还原。每次读前都取磁盘证据(`resolved version: 1.7.1`、1.7.1-only 标记 `scimManagedConnection` = 15、rc.1-only 标记 `scimGroupRoleGrant` = 0,rc.1 侧反之)。⇒ **不是「相信它换过去了」,是每一腿都证明了自己在读哪个产物。**

### Zone-2 三条,全部答到点上

**①「是构造调用形状不匹配,不是比较逻辑坏了」—— 确认,而且给出了为什么必然死在 collection**:稳定版工厂的**第一条语句**就是 `validateConnections(options)`,它在任何存在性检查之前读 `options.connections.length`;而 schema 在 describe 体**和** `for` 头里都要读 ⇒ 抛在**收集阶段**,整个文件死掉,打印 TypeError 而不是它承诺的模型清单。构造成功之后下游比较逻辑**正确且有信息量,无需改动**。

**② 未移 pin** —— 见上。

**③ 恰好七个** —— 而且是**报出来的,不是凑出来的**。我在派发里写死「⛔ 不许把七当成目标去迎合」,它照办,并把条件性 managed 三件**单独用探针测**、明说门禁**刻意不配置** `managedConnections`(auth manager 不传它,配了就会让门禁去比一个没有任何 ObjectStack 部署会 provision 的面)。

### ⭐ 两条对照,一条证明无回归,一条证明没变窄

- **LEG A vs LEG E** —— 在**钉住的 rc.1** 上,修复后与修复前**都是 `24 passed (24)`**。⇒ **这次修复对 CI 实际跑的那个版本零影响**;它改变的只是「pin 移动那一天会发生什么」。这是无回归的直接证据,不是论证。
- **LEG F 选项形状等价性** —— 便宜构造(`connections: []` + 从不被调用的 `verifyBearerToken`)与**真实静态连接**得到 `SETS EQUAL: true`、**每个模型列集相等**。⇒ **「最便宜」不等于「比较得更少」**,这正是这类修复最容易悄悄变成窄化的地方。

⭐ 而且该探针的**第一次尝试失败了**:缺 `credentials` 的连接项在 `index.mjs:7058` 抛同样的 TypeError。这次失败被**写进文件的 docblock**,而不是悄悄重试掉 —— 一个「半配置的输入并不比空输入更小」的事实,下一个人不必再撞一次。

### ⭐⭐ 一处棘轮意识,我独立验过

`constructScim()` 把 vendor 错误**拼进 message 字符串**,而不是用 `new Error(msg, { cause })`。注释给的理由是:本包编译在 `lib: es2020`,`ErrorOptions` 不存在,那种写法是 **TS2554**,会落进 plugin-auth **shrink-only 的 TEST_DEBT 计数**。

**我核了:** 根 `tsconfig.json` 是 `"target": "ES2020"` / `"lib": ["ES2020"]`,`plugin-auth/tsconfig.json` `extends` 它。`ErrorOptions` 是 ES2022 才有的。⇒ **理由成立。** 而 `cause` 仍通过 `Object.assign` 挂着,供会拆包的读者用。

⚠️ 顺带印证了另一件事:`plugin-auth/tsconfig.json` **`exclude` 了 `**/*.test.ts`** —— 这正是它必须自建一个「TEST_DEBT 形状的 tsc 工程」(package tsconfig + 显式 files 列表还原隐藏的 116 个测试文件)才能测到这条改动的原因。97 → 97 零变化,**并带反向对照**:注入一个故意的类型错误使计数变成 99 并点名该文件 ⇒ **仪器看得见这个文件,所以那个零是测量,不是盲点。**

### 最耐久的部分:让下一次失败可读

裸的 vendor `TypeError` 读起来像「门禁坏了」—— 而**上一次它就是这样让一个迁移轮报废的**。现在构造失败会重抛一条指名道姓的错误:这是**构造不匹配,不是 parity 失败**,请更新 `SCIM_GATE_OPTIONS` 到该版本接受的形状,然后读门禁打印的模型差异。

⇒ 这把一次「declared-not-enforced」修成了**声明即强制**,并且把下一次版本漂移的诊断成本从「读源码猜」降到「读错误信息」。

### 状态

CI 在 `7544c02b5b` 上:**29 项完成全绿、零失败**,`Test Core (1/6)` 与 `Lint & Repo Gates` 仍 `in_progress`。4 项 `skipped` 为路径过滤/被取代运行的重复条目。

⛔ **尚未翻牌。Clause-② `no`** ⇒ 收敛全绿后由本席直接翻牌入队,不需要契约复审档位。

⚠️ **已挂自检回来完成翻牌。** 本车道今天有过一次同形失误(#10692:复核写了「暂不翻牌,CI 收敛中」,然后没有人回来,卡挂了 10 小时),不指望运气。

`pnpm lint` 该轮**完整跑了**,未声明任何窄化;唯一声明的窄化是 `check:type-check-debt --re-measure`(需整仓构建,CI 拥有它),且用上面那个带反向对照的替代测量补上了。

## 翻牌 + 入队完成 —— CI 在 `7544c02b5b` 上收敛全绿

承接 `5387612968`(ACCEPT,当时两项未收敛)。**这一轮回来做完了**,自检未落空。

按 job 名读,**34 项全部完成、零失败**。上一轮悬着的两项均已转绿:`Test Core (1/6)` **success**(18:05:35)、`Lint & Repo Gates` **success**(18:03:55)。

5 项 `skipped`,如实记为「未运行」而非凑进绿灯数:`Build Docs` 与 `Console Pin Gate` 是路径过滤(本 diff 是单个测试文件);`Auto Label`/`Check Changeset`/`Check PR Size` 三项是被取代那次运行的重复条目 —— **同名 job 在本 PR 上各有一条真实的 `success`**,按 job id 与运行 id 逐条比对确认,不是看名字重复就当过了。

⛔ 全程按 job 名读,未采用 rollup。

**Clause-② `no`,复验而非继承**(单个测试文件;pin、`auth-manager.ts`、两处脚手架抑制、`packages/spec` 全部未动)⇒ 无需契约复审档位,派发席权限之内:`draft: false`,自动合并已装(SQUASH),入合并队列。

### 本卡的目的已经达成,与合并无关

⭐ #11380 存在的理由是**让 #3653 拿到一份真实的 diff**。那份 diff 已于 `3653#issuecomment-5387582046` 贴出(逐字原文),**#3653 已随之从 `pm:blocked` 移回 `needs-user-decision`**,等待维护者裁定迁移路径。⇒ 那一步**不依赖本 PR 合入**,已经完成了。

### 落地后仍然成立的一条

⚠️ 这次修复**对 CI 实际跑的版本零影响** —— 在钉住的 `1.7.0-rc.1` 上,修复前后都是 `24 passed (24)`。它改变的是**「pin 移动那一天会发生什么」**:届时门禁会打印模型差异清单,而不是一个不说明问题的 `TypeError`。

标准运维提示不变:SCIM 默认关闭,**group 供给不通** —— 今天开启 SCIM 的部署不要让 IdP 推送 group,直到迁移落地。
